description: This file contains platform-specific initialization and reboot functions for the ESP32-C3 SoC within the Zephyr RTOS, including startup routines, interrupt controller initialization, and system restart procedures.

methods.name: __esp_platform_start
methods.description: Performs platform-specific startup initialization, including setting up the global pointer, vector table, disabling interrupts, initializing the clock, and starting Zephyr.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Outputs a character to UART, handling newline translation.

methods.name: esp_restart_noos
methods.description: Performs system restart by disabling interrupts, resetting peripherals, and entering an infinite loop.
